quote: To evaluate the reasoning capabilities of LLMs when presented with transient information in tables, we created a question-answering dataset in which answers cannot be derived from a single table alone.

We define a question-answering task and create an associated dataset, TRANSIENTTABLES, where the answers require understanding and reasoning across at least two distinct tables sampled from different time periods.
outputs: Concise answers (5-10 words) to questions about temporally evolving tables
The generated outputs are answers to questions based on temporally evolving semi-structured tables.
